parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Geographical WGS84 coordinates. Multiple coordinates can be comma separated.

parameters.name: hourly
parameters.description: A list of weather variables which should be returned.

parameters.name: daily
parameters.description: A list of daily weather variable aggregations.

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: A list of variables to return for the current conditions.

parameters.name: minutely_15
parameters.description: A list of weather variables at 15-minute intervals.

parameters.name: timeformat
parameters.description: If format unixtime is selected, all time values are returned in UNIX epoch time.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Any IANA time zone name is supported. Use auto to resolve the local time zone.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of the time interval in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of the time interval in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: tilt
parameters.description: Slope tilt in degrees for global_tilted_irradiance calculation.

parameters.name: azimuth
parameters.description: Azimuth for global_tilted_irradiance. North=0, East=90, South=180, West=270.

parameters.name: cell_selection
parameters.description: Grid cell selection preference: land, sea, or nearest.

parameters.name: models
parameters.description: Manually select one or more weather models.

endpoints.description: Open-Meteo offers free weather forecast APIs for open-source developers and non-commercial use.
